text:
amy_support: Hey team — AtlasPay reporting a p99 latency jump hitting /v1/generate since ~12:30 UTC. Customers seeing timeouts.

maria_sre: Looking now. Do we have a metrics snapshot? Any deploys around 12:15–12:20?

amy_support: p95 went ~300ms -> 1.1s, p99 ~900ms -> 6-8s. No auth/billing errors in the logs. Customer: "sudden lag, some requests 8-10s".

jake_platform: There was a small runtime experiment deployed at 12:14 that changed coalescer defaults. Not intentional for atlas tenants. deploy-bot: canary deploy kicked at 12:14 UTC.

maria_sre: Checking node configs for atlaspay shard...

ops-bot: runtime pods for atlas shard: runtime-xx-7, runtime-xx-8 show coalescer.wait_ms=80

maria_sre: 80ms is high. Previous default was 10ms. Combined with max_batch_size=64 this will hurt low-qps tenants — explains tail.

amy_support: Was that experiment flagged incorrectly?

jake_platform: Yeah, feature flag targeting broke; experiment config leaked into prod atlas shard. It was meant for background high-throughput workloads.

maria_sre: Repro steps I ran: small prompts at low QPS -> coalescer accumulates, KV cache churn causes extra delay, leading to p99 blowups.

maria_sre: Repro script:
```
for i in 1..50; do curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}' & sleep 0.2; done
```
Under coalesce_wait=80ms + small QPS, ~10-30% responses exceed 2s.

maria_sre: Quick mitigation plan: revert the experiment targeting for prod atlas shards and hotpatch coalescer settings to safer defaults (wait_ms=12, max_batch_size=16).

jake_platform: Applying hotpatch now: 
kubectl patch configmap coalescer-config -n runtime --type merge -p '{"data":{"atlas_coalesce_wait_ms":"12","atlas_max_batch_size":"16"}}'

deploy-bot: configmap patched; signaling reload to runtime-xx-7, runtime-xx-8.

ops-bot: pods reloaded, new coalescer.wait_ms=12 confirmed on both nodes.

maria_sre: Immediate metrics: p95 from ~1.1s -> ~320ms within 40s; p99 from ~7.9s -> ~850ms. Still watching for regressions.

amy_support: Customer updated: "latency back to normal, thanks".

maria_sre: Postmortem items: add guardrail to rollout system so coalesce.wait_ms cannot be >30ms for tenants with steady QPS < 5r/s; add perf test that exercises low-QPS small-prompt path. Filing SRE-682.

jake_platform: I will change the rollout gating to require explicit tenant whitelist for coalescer experiments and add the staging perf job.

sre-oncall: Marking incident resolved; monitoring for 2 hours. :white_check_mark:
